mechanism_narrative: The level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as a strong labor market supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between PAYEMS level and 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A Fed Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% signals a tight monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as the market prices in the risk of recession.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between CPIAUCSL (inflation) and FEDFUNDS (policy rate) forms a signal: when inflation is rising (CPIAUCSL > 200.0) and the Fed Funds rate is below 5.0%, it signals an accommodative policy stance that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction signal (CPIAUCSL>200.0 AND FEDFUNDS<5.0) and 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (characterized by high HOUST and RSAFS), the S&P 500 is expected to produce positive forward returns over the next 20 days as the economy approaches its peak and earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the regime condition (HOUST>1800.0 AND RSAFS>360000.0) and 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as wage pressures boost consumer spending and corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between HOUST (housing starts) and INDPRO (industrial production) forms a signal: when housing starts are above 1800.0 and industrial production is above 110.0, it signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction signal (HOUST>1800.0 AND INDPRO>110.0) and 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation, low-policy-rate regime (CPIAUCSL > 200.0 and FEDFUNDS < 5.0), the S&P 500 is expected to produce positive forward returns over the next 20 days as the market prices in the inflation premium and accommodative policy.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the regime condition (CPIAUCSL>200.0 AND FEDFUNDS<5.0) and 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0 signals strong manufacturing activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as the economy expands and corporate earnings grow.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO level and 60d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
